name: Winter Whiskers
description:
About This Game

Winter Whiskers is a cozy cleaning sim focused on clearing snow, fixing steam networks, and reconnecting a seaside town after an unexpected blizzard. As you clear roads and fulfill simple requests from your neighbors, you’ll bring warmth back to this littlel community - just in time for the annual Winter Festival!

Clear away the snow ❄️

Use your snow vacuum to clear snow drifts and make the town safe to traverse. Unlock new ways to clear icy obsticals and get to tricky spots.

Fix the Steam System 💨

Restore the town’s steam-powered network by fueling furnaces and reconnecting pipes. This helps melt the snow even faster, clears giant snow drifts, and ultimately warms up the town.

Help Your Friends 💖

The blizzard has disrupted everything! Help locals with small tasks—clearing storefronts, completeing important deliveries, and more—so that they can focus on the Winter Festival.

Features

✅ What Winter Whiskers offers:

  • A short, laid-back adventure: Spend 2–3 hours exploring the four areas of Winterlight Harbor. Progress through the town as you reconnect key locations and help your friends prepare for the Winter Festival.

  • Simple game mechanics: Linearly progress through areas as you vacuum up snow, restore warmth through steam-powered systems, and use a growing set of tools to clear stubborn obstacles.

  • A warm and cozy vibe: A peaceful winter atmosphere with soft early morning light, colorful seaside homes, adorable characters, and a gentle soundtrack.

  • There is no possibility of failure: play at your own pace!

❌ What Winter Whiskers does NOT offer:

  • No open-world exploration: just 4 peaceful areas to explore.

  • No time management or complex mechanics: just simple snow clearing, cozy steam puzzles, and requests from NPCs. 

  • No multiplayer of any kind.

About the Devs

Hiya! We're Axie and Leaf - the small team of Mango Leaf Games! We're so excited to share our next game with you! We learned a lot after making our first game, Kokoro Kitchen, and we've used it to create a quiet, relaxed game centered around the beautiful stillness of a snowy day. 

We're continuing to grow with each project and still consider ourselves beginners. Please be kind with your expectations, and know that we will do our best! We hope you enjoy our little cleaning sim, Winter Whiskers!
short_desc: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!
